page_title: Text With Authors - Chat with Famous Authors and Literary Giants Using AI

sources.entry: Text With Authors - Chat with famous authors, poets, playwrights, philosophers and more from classical literature. #freemium

summary.name: Text With Authors
summary.one_liner: An AI chatbot app for holding conversations with famous classical authors, poets, playwrights and philosophers such as Shakespeare, Dickinson and Socrates.
use_cases: Conversing with classic authors about their works
Studying classical literature with an AI tutor
Exploring philosophy through chats with Socrates or Plato
Learning literature in a non-English language
summary.what_it_does: The app lets users chat with AI versions of mostly public-domain authors, poets, playwrights and philosophers, based on their public writings and historical records. It includes literary tutors for topics such as classical, romantic and Victorian literature and philosophy. Users can request Voicemails, which are spoken messages in each figure's voice, and a daily classic poem is offered. The page says the chatbots use GPT-5 and support over 100 languages.
notable: Voicemails: authors leave spoken messages in distinct voices
Literary tutors for classical, romantic, Victorian literature and philosophy
Figures remember facts about the user per figure
caveats: Full author range, unlimited messaging and advanced features require a premium subscription
Voicemail credits are limited (30 per month for premium subscribers) and extra credits are purchased
Mostly limited to public-domain authors who died before 1923; not an e-book reader
